title: Song Stats

mostOpened.title: MOST OPENED
mostOpened.hint: Songs you opened to read. Opening a song isn’t the same as singing it, so this list is kept separate.
mostOpened.empty: No songs opened in this period.

newSongs.title: NEW TO YOUR SETS
newSongs.hint: Songs you sang for the first time in this period.

rotation.title: IN HEAVY ROTATION
rotation.hint: These were in at least {{min}} of your last {{of}} sets.

repeat.title: CARRIED OVER
repeat.body: {{percent}}% of the songs in your last {{count}} sets were also in the {{count}} before.

resting.title: NOT SUNG IN A WHILE
resting.hint: You haven’t sung these in the last {{months}} months.

longTime.title: LONG-TIME SONGS
longTime.hint: Songs you’ve sung since early on and still sing today.

gate.title: Song Stats appears after {{count}} sets
gate.body: A set counts when you run it in Worship Mode for a few minutes while signed in. You’ve run {{done}} so far.

off: Song Stats is off, so new sets aren’t being recorded.

about.title: Song Stats
about.intro: Song Stats is built from the sets you run and the songs you open in GraceChords.
about.rule: A set counts when you run it in Worship Mode while signed in: at least {{perSong}} minutes for each song, and never less than {{min}} minutes. A song counts when it’s on screen for {{seconds}} seconds or more.
about.private: Your stats are yours. No other GraceChords user can see them. Song counts across all users are added up anonymously to help decide what to build next.
about.control: You can clear your history or turn Song Stats off at any time.

preview.title: PREVIEW
preview.hint: Only admins and development builds see these switches.
